title: SkyPlace: A New Mixed-size Placement Framework using Modularity-based Clustering and SDP Relaxation
problem: Mixed-size placement in chip design lacks effective initialization strategies and methods to handle large macros within analytical placement frameworks. Current electrostatics-based placement algorithms fail to adequately address placement initialization and macro handling together.
motivation: Effective placement initialization and macro handling are critical for achieving optimal wirelength, timing, area, and power in modern chip designs.
method: SkyPlace introduces macro-aware clustering for intelligent placement initialization by grouping components based on connectivity and size characteristics. It employs semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxation to handle large macros within the analytical placement framework while maintaining solution quality. The approach extends electrostatics-based placement with specialized mechanisms for mixed-size components.
key_novelty: Macro-aware clustering combined with SDP relaxation to address placement initialization and large macro handling in mixed-size analytical placement.
contributions: Macro-aware clustering technique for placement initialization
SDP relaxation framework for handling large macros in analytical placement
Integrated mixed-size placement framework combining clustering and SDP
Superior performance over leading-edge academic placers on benchmarks

metrics.other: improved wirelength and timing on academic benchmarks (specific numbers not provided)
